families.name: fee-ids-for-merchant-period
families.pattern: (applicable fee ids for <merchant>|fee ids applicable to <merchant>)
families.operation: the fee rules whose criteria match a merchant's transactions in a day, month or year
families.invariant: ids(day) ⊆ ids(month) ⊆ ids(year) for one merchant

families.name: fee-ids-by-attributes
families.pattern: fee id or ids that apply to account_type
families.operation: the fee rules whose account_type and aci fields match, wildcards included
families.invariant: rules with both fields null appear in every (account_type, aci) answer

families.name: total-fees-paid
families.operation: sum of fee(rule, transaction) over every matching rule for a merchant in a period
families.invariant: Σ months = year; Σ days of a month = month

families.name: delta-fee-rate-change
families.pattern: delta would <merchant> pay if the relative fee
families.operation: fees under a rule with its rate replaced, minus fees under the rule as is
families.invariant: delta is linear in (new − old) rate; an unchanged rate gives 0

families.name: delta-mcc-change
families.operation: yearly fees with the merchant's MCC swapped, minus yearly fees as is
families.invariant: the merchant's own MCC gives 0; delta = fees(new) − fees(old), both via F03

families.name: merchants-affected-by-fee
families.pattern: (which merchants would have been affected|which merchants were affected by the fee)
families.operation: the merchants with at least one transaction matching a rule (or losing it under a change)
families.invariant: affected ⊆ merchants matching the rule today

families.name: average-fee-for-scheme
families.pattern: average fee that the card scheme <scheme> would charge
families.operation: mean of fee(rule, value) over the scheme's rules that match the stated filters
families.invariant: avg(value) is affine in value; a narrower filter uses a subset of rules

families.name: cheapest-or-priciest-choice
families.pattern: (most expensive authorization|in the average scenario, which card scheme|most expensive mcc)
families.operation: the same per-option fee table F07 averages, then argmin or argmax over options
families.invariant: the chosen option's cost is ≤ (or ≥) every alternative in the same table; max ≥ mean

families.name: steer-traffic-scheme
families.operation: a merchant's period fees recomputed per card scheme, then argmin or argmax
families.invariant: min-scheme ≠ max-scheme; per-scheme totals reconcile with F03's total

families.name: move-fraud-to-aci
families.pattern: move the fraudulent transactions towards a different authorization
families.operation: fees on the merchant's fraudulent transactions recomputed per ACI, then argmin
families.invariant: the chosen ACI's cost is ≤ every alternative in the same table

families.name: avg-value-grouped-by
families.operation: mean eur_amount of a merchant's scheme transactions in a month range, per group
families.invariant: the count-weighted mean of the groups equals the ungrouped mean

families.name: easy-descriptive
families.operation: descriptive statistics over payments.csv; format discipline, not fee logic
families.invariant: two runs agree and the answer matches the guideline format
